alt: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel wearing chunky oversized black Snap Specs AR glasses while being interviewed by TV camera at the 2026 Specs launch event, with 'SPECS' branding signage visible behind him
story: Snap launched 'Specs' AR glasses on June 16, 2026 at $2,195 — CEO Evan Spiegel described them as 'highly wearable' at the launch event in footage that visibly shows the 136-gram chunky frames flattening his earlobes, the company's top Specs exec had already quit, and Snap stock fell ~10% on launch day.
why_funny: The CEO used himself as a live product demo to prove wearability and simultaneously demonstrated the opposite, on camera, at the launch event.
